children: Royal Canadian Mint closed a follow-on offering of 501,175 gold exchange-traded receipts at C$65.82 each for gross proceeds of C$32.99M. The new ETRs are listed on the TSX and are fungible with existing ETRs.
Confirms demand and sets reference price for ETRs.
Adds gold-backed float; incremental bullion demand signal.
Defines metal entitlement; frames NAV vs market price.
Anchors price to bullion; limits persistent premium/discount.

This is an incremental expansion of the Mint’s Canadian Gold Reserves ETR program, reinforcing ongoing investor demand for physical-gold-backed receipts. A larger catalyst would be outsized issuance, premium/discount shifts, or changes to entitlement or fees impacting NAV dynamics.
